dct_description_sm: Beyond warnings of the timing and consequences of an ice-free Northwest Passage, northerners have yet to see a comprehensive picture of the socio-economic, cultural and environmental changes that will occur over the next 20 years and beyond. 2030 North explored the full consequences of what is occurring in the Arctic and what people could be experiencing in 2030. Big picture, strategic thinking is urgently needed to establish long-term public policy objectives, programs, goals and values, replacing those developed in the 1980s and 1990s. The conference will begin to build a new northern strategy that truly reflects the growing domestic and international importance of the Arctic.
